description: Build the package an estimate_download counted, in the background: ZIP parts of about 10 GB, each with MANIFEST.csv and MISSING.csv. `include` is `all` (default) or `pdf` (report PDFs only, often far smaller). The signed-in user is emailed when it is ready, with the download links; the package is kept for 14 days. Over 200 GB it waits for staff approval (state `awaiting_approval`). One package per user at a time. If the same files are already packaged and kept, that package is returned (`reused`).
name: prepare_download
title: Package documents for download
